title: fix(skills): narrow eval must_not_contain entries their own reference answer writes, and refuse the pattern in check-skill-eval-tokens
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBNkrjeNBWqag99dzzuEttK)_

Fixes #31278

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:14 个技能评测用例里,`must_not_contain`(禁止出现的字符串)和该用例自己的参考答案撞车,共 21 条;逐条收窄成错误答案才会写出的代码形状(如 `fuzzy` 改为 `fuzzy:`、`definePage` 改为 `definePage(`),objectui 的 `props.value` / `props.label` 合并为一条 `"props": {`。另在已有的评测校验脚本 `check-skill-eval-tokens` 里加一条拒绝:禁止串出现在本用例参考答案里即报错。
- 为什么改:按参考答案那样写、只是点名「不要这样写」的正确回答,会被自己的断言判失败,评测分数失真。
- 风险与回滚:只动评测 JSON 与一个 CI 校验脚本,不改任何技能正文与运行时;收窄后少数非常规写法(多行对象、JSON 引号键)可能漏判。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-upgrade/evals/protocol-major-upgrade.json`(`?? ` 带尾随空格);`skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json`(`slots: { tabs`);`ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` 新增的 `forbids-own-answer` 分支。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs --self-test`(在 `ui/` 下运行),预期 `OK ... 31 cases pass`;再跑不带参数的同一命令,预期 exit 0。
- 需要你做的:审阅并以授权账号批准(Tier H,`skills/**`)。

## What changes

A `must_not_contain` assertion fails an answer that contains the string anywhere, including a sentence naming it as the form to avoid. Re-swept on `main` 216b18a6 (each entry against a substring of the same case's `expected_output`): **21 of 298 entries in 14 cases** hit. The card listed 15 cases; `objectstack-automation/evals/integrations-declared.json` case 1 (`connector-esign`) no longer hits on `main` (its reference answer changed in #31377), so it is untouched.

Every entry is narrowed; none is dropped (one is merged, see `objectui` case 1):

| File | Case | Was | Now |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `objectstack-api/evals/endpoints-auth-routes.json` | 3 | `http.server` | `'http.server'` |
| same | 7 | `?ids=`, `?filter=` | `object?ids=`, `object?filter=` |
| `objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` | 1 | `type: 'password'` | `{ type: 'password'` |
| same | 2 | `many_to_many` | `type: 'many_to_many'` |
| `objectstack-query/evals/filters-pagination-search.json` | 3 | `distinct: true` | `distinct: true,` and `distinct: true }` |
| same | 4 | `fuzzy` | `fuzzy:` |
| `objectstack-ui/evals/analytics-inline-vs-dataset.json` | 1 | `valueField` | `valueField:` |
| `objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json` | 1 | `definePage`, `slots.tabs`, `kind: 'full'` | `definePage(`, `slots: { tabs`, `kind: 'full',` |
| same | 3 | `slots.tabs` | `slots: { tabs` |
| `objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` | 11 | `submitLabel`, `confirmLabel`, `confirmText` | each with its colon |
| same | 12 | `$or`, `anyOf` | `$or:`, `anyOf:` (as the case's own `logic:` / `conditions:`) |
| `objectstack-upgrade/evals/protocol-major-upgrade.json` | 2 | `??` | `?? ` (operator plus the space before its operand) |
| `objectui/evals/schema-expressions.json` | 1 | `props.value`, `props.label` | one `"props": {` (the quoted envelope, as `page-builder.json` case 2) |
| same | 2 | `props.label` | `"props": {` |

The guard is folded into the existing eval validator, `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs`, as one more refusal beside its `must_not_contain` shape check (reason `forbids-own-answer`, exit 1), with two `--self-test` cases and one vitest pin in the existing `must_not_contain` describe block. No new script. Its population is the one it already walks, the `skills/objectui` bundle; the other bundles' evals have no validator (see Acceptance notes).

Line readings (`skills/**`): changed files before → after: api 75 → 75, data 263 → 263, query 75 → 75, ui analytics 87 → 87, ui record-page 56 → 56, ui views 125 → 125, upgrade 55 → 55, objectui schema-expressions 54 → 53. Whole bundle: all `SKILL.md` 4553 → 4553; all of `skills/**` 20316 → 20315. No skill text changes. Eval fixtures are measured, not ratcheted, by `check-skills-token-ratchet` (exit 0).

## Tests

- Sweep on the final head 9f5b77b0: `hits 0 of 320 must_not_contain entries` (main merged in, which added cases).
- `node scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs --self-test` (from `ui/`): `OK ... 31 cases pass`; gate run exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-skill-eval-tokens.test.ts` (from `ui/`, locked): 30 passed.
- Reverse leg: `schema-expressions.json` restored to 216b18a6 → gate exit 1 with three `forbids-own-answer` rows (cases 1 and 2), restored from HEAD → exit 0, blob equal to HEAD.
- Ablation via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (refusal condition replaced by `|| true`): self-test `1 of 31 case(s) failed`, vitest `1 failed | 29 passed`; restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `pnpm --dir ui run type-check:scripts` exit 0; eslint on both touched ui files exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Coverage gap: the refusal guards only the `skills/objectui` bundle, the population `check-skill-eval-tokens` already walks; 18 of today's 21 entries sit in six other bundles that no eval validator reads. Widening it is a scope decision reported to the seat, not taken here.
- Narrowed entries keep blind spots a substring cannot avoid: a multi-line `slots: {` / `tabs:` object, a JSON-quoted `"$or":` key, a `Field.password(` helper call.
